title: Data and normalization predicates for localized ordinary pullback
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$, and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X''\xrightarrow hX'\xrightarrow gX$ be morphisms of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use their small pro-etale sites and canonical inverse images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For $W=X,X',X''$, put $B_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_W$, with projections $\pi_{W,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $E_W=B_W[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Use module sheaves, sheaf tensor products and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a morphism $u:V\to W$, let $d_{u,n}:u^{-1}(A/\varpi^n)_W\to(A/\varpi^n)_V$ be the canonical constant-section map and $c_u:u^{-1}B_W\to B_V$ the map with components $d_{u,n}u^{-1}\pi_{W,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Set $P_u=B_V\otimes^L_{u^{-1}B_W}u^{-1}(-)$, with canonical ordinary composition $a:P_hP_g\xrightarrow\sim P_{g\circ h}$ and identity $e:P_{\mathrm{id}}\xrightarrow\sim\mathrm{id}$ [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Set $F_W=E_W\otimes^L_{B_W}(-)$ and $G_u=E_V\otimes^L_{u^{-1}E_W}u^{-1}(-)$. In defining these functors use the canonical localization-unit comparison $u^{-1}E_W\cong(u^{-1}B_W)[1/\varpi]$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-inverse-image-coherence]. Let $\delta_u:F_VP_u\xrightarrow\sim G_uF_W$ be the balanced comparison through $E_V\otimes^L_{u^{-1}B_W}u^{-1}(-)$, whose inverse inserts the coefficient unit; let $b:G_hG_g\xrightarrow\sim G_{g\circ h}$ and $e_E:G_{\mathrm{id}}\xrightarrow\sim\mathrm{id}$ be the ordinary rational comparisons.

Define Edge for u to be the type of a localized coefficient map d_u^E together with an ordinary natural isomorphism F_V^0 P_u^0 ≅ G_u^0 F_W^0 and a derived natural isomorphism F_V P_u ≅ G_u F_W, subject to the following normalizations. The coefficient map satisfies d_u^E u^{-1}ι_W=ι_V c_u. The ordinary map sends e tensor (b times the integral unit of m) to e ι_V(b) times the rational unit of 1 tensor m; its inverse on e times that rational unit is e tensor the integral unit. The derived map on every flat-term K-flat complex is the ordinary map degreewise, conjugated by the specified computation counits. Here P_u^0 is the actual completed coefficient module inverse image, F_W^0 is ordinary extension along ι_W, and G_u^0 is inverse image over u^{-1}R_W followed by ordinary extension along d_u^E.

For supplied edges for g,h and gh, define Composition to consist of the coefficient-composition equation under the canonical inverse-image compositor, ordinary and derived rational compositors G_h G_g ≅ G_{gh}, the ordinary rational tensor formula e'' tensor (e' tensor m) mapping to e'' d_h^E(e') tensor m with inverse inserting 1, the degreewise model equation on flat-term K-flat complexes, the ordinary delta-composition square, its mixed-generator formula with scalar e'' ι_Z(c_h(b')), and the derived delta-composition square on every unbounded derived object. Canonical fiber-product pasting supplies the chart restrictions in these equations.

For a supplied edge for id_X, define Identity to consist of its coefficient-identity equation, ordinary G_id^0 ≅ id with scalar-multiplication formula and identity-chart restriction, derived G_id ≅ id with its resolving-model equation, and the ordinary and derived delta-identity squares. Define Coefficients to be the proposition asserting finite coefficient composition, completed coefficient composition, the equation obtained by postcomposing the iterated completed maps with each finite projection, finite and completed identity, quotient-transition compatibility for every scheme morphism and every arrow of the positive-level tower, and preservation of every constant scalar from A by the completed map and its adjunction unit. These are predicates and data types only: their definitions assert no witnesses. All declarations, including the exact field equations, are relocated verbatim from the original normalization module.

mathlib_searches.query: Derived pullback of sheaves of modules commutes with extension of scalars and localization compatibly with composition and identity
mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, headed by SheafOfModules.pullbackComp, pullback_assoc, pullback_comp_id, freeFunctorCompPullbackIso. Read Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Sheaf/PullbackContinuous.lean. These ordinary pullback comparisons do not provide the normalized comparison between the actual integral and localized derived pullbacks.
12 hits, beginning with CategoryTheory.Limits.pullbackComparison. They concern categorical pullbacks rather than the scalar-localization comparison of module-sheaf functors.

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including CategoryTheory.constantCommuteCompose and SheafOfModules.pullbackComp. Read the existing ProfiniteCoefficientInverseImage implementation: its proved constant comparison lemmas are usable for the coefficient proof, but none of these hits states a normalized localized edge or its derived composition square.

Local rg in lean/Sheaf and lean/WeilConjectures found CompletedTowerPullback, ProfiniteCoefficientInverseImage, PbcScalarExtension and CompletedCoefficientRingedCoherence.
